save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer and scheduler state to disk
load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer and scheduler state from disk
load_model_only: load only the model state dict from a checkpoint file without optimizer or scheduler
check_checkpoint_exists: check if a last_checkpoint file exists in the save directory
get_checkpoint_path: get the path of the most recently saved checkpoint file from the save directory
